notes.title: Canvas Menagerie is out now!
notes.content:
After 3 years of development, Canvas Menagerie is now fully playable!

Canvas Menagerie is a comfy slice-of-life boys love romance about a group of actors going through their mid-20s together while filming together. Follow Niko, a transmasc TV actor as he falls for his celebrity costar who plays his rival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/1ba1ca59fcade726a2db111f5436b2a29e514c04.png[/img]

The final game is over 135k words long with 15+ CGs and 10+ characters spread out over 3 main Acts, so around 10+ hours of playtime.

While the story is mostly wholesome and meant to be a comfy experience, there are some content notes to be aware about as this game features:
[list]
[*] Adults drinking and being inebriated
[*] Adults smoking
[*] Mentions of gender dysphoria
[*] Cursing
[/list]
An artbook is also for sale, featuring 75 pages of artwork, sketches, concept notes, and more for the story. It does contain spoilers, though, so please only read it after finishing the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409480/Canvas_Menagerie_Artbook/

You can get both for sale now as a bundle.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48746/Canvas_Menagerie_Deluxe_Edition/

We're also have a [url=https://ko-fi.com/crystalgameworks/link/WINTER2024]Winter Sale on our merch store[/url]! It's 10% off all merch if you use code WINTER2024...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/42e9c6a26b4a041f99e89daee0c0653281bf31bd.jpg[/img]

...including the [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/a8b192c573]physical copy of the game[/url]! It's a deluxe edition which means the CD contains the full game + artbook PDF as well as a Steam key for both.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/88ea123c20646ac908685f48e1a1442f8089da89.jpg[/img]

Thank you for the continued support the past 3 years!

— Arimia

p.s. the cover artwork is by [url=https://x.com/Lycoristyx]Lycoristyx[/url]!

notes.title: July Updates - Writing Complete
notes.content:
It’s the start of August so it’s time to look back at progress made in July, of which there were a lot. First off and more importantly, the first draft for the entirety of Canvas Menagerie is complete!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/431c2d4c23bd6a58578a830d8914381b6b053561.jpg[/img]

Act 1 & 2 are already past the first draft with Act 1 currently receiving final touches from beta testing, and now Act 3 is joining them as being fully drafted.

The final wordcount on the documents is 153k words, though once it’s ported to Ren’Py this number will go down slightly, so more realistically the full game will be around 140k words with Act 2 being the shortest (but only slightly). Here’s a small snippet of a scene in Act 3 where Niko is wishing Ren off at the airport.
[quote]Niko “You’ve got your passport, right? And ID? And chargers? And medicine?”
Ren “Who needs to make a checklist when I have you?”
Niko “That’s the problem. You’re not going to have me for a few weeks.”
Ren stops walking, making me almost run into him. He steps towards me, takes off one side of his mask, and kisses me.
Niko “You’re going to be caught on camera.”
Ren “What’s so bad about that?”
I lean in and give him one more quick kiss. If I stay this close to him I won’t want to let him go.
Niko “If you get lonely in your hotel room, you can call me.”
Ren “Lonely? How do you know I won’t be out enjoying the nightlife? They have actual markets over there, you know.”
Niko “That’d require you to care about getting out.”
Ren “Everywhere I go I’m the life of the party. I’ll send you photos, don’t worry.”
Niko “I’m sure I’ll see them online before you get the chance to.”
Niko “Just...try not to push yourself too much.”
Ren “You should worry about yourself. If I’m not here to kick you out of bed you’re going to keep skipping practice, aren’t you?”
Niko “I didn’t skip, it just wasn’t in person!!”
Ren “Trying to make yourself feel better now, huh?”
I raise my hand in protest, but he puts his hand on my head.
Ren “I’ll be back before you know it.”[/quote]
Act 1 is their meet cute and working through their differences until they realize there’s a connection there. Act 2 is the beginning of their romantic relationship as a couple, slowly getting to know each other better and navigating their everyday lives as a new couple. Act 3 is their relationship growing and being tested to see if they truly understand the person they’re with and what baggage the other person has.

When I set out to make Canvas Menagerie, I knew that their growing feelings for each other (while unadmitted) was just the beginning of their story and the true meat of it was them navigating life together.

Aside from just writing, though, I also made substantial progress on scripting! I’m currently halfway through scripting Act 2 to get it ready for beta testers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/20373a8c772e3e6d449a6ce5823ecc3d9e3c816e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/9bbf7a840f14aea034af55cdb5bc48ca9d242df3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/cb30987b5939e94c8100bdd6a5523427ab0a298e.jpg[/img]

I’m hoping to wrap up scripting Act 2 by the end of August and sending it off to beta testers. If you’re interested in testing it, join our public [url=https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4]Discord server[/url]! I’ll be sharing the beta testing info there as well as on [url=https://mailchi.mp/4e122e9a1446/cgw-newsletter]our newsletter[/url].

Last but not least, it’ll be in the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/url] on Steam next week!

— Arimia

notes.title: May Updates – Editing & Playtesting
notes.content:
May was a very hectic month for me personally, so there wasn’t much progress made this month – but that doesn’t mean there wasn’t any!

I wrote about 4k words for Canvas Menagerie. I also did a fair amount of editing for Act 2 of Canvas Menagerie, proofreading what’s there and trying to make sure it all fits together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/6de0d4c74e04976752cea275b90ffe03bfbd8909.jpg[/img]

There’s one somewhat frustrating character in particular that is fully introduced in Act 2 who’s named Rose – I won’t go into who he is for spoiler reasons, but I will talk a bit about him as a person. Rose is a very secretive person with low self-esteem and not a solid self-image of himself. He’s quiet and can come across as rude because of how little he responds to others, preferring to keep to himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/4a6dd9f4062668ffa0ac43b7c5f1f7de1035a5a5.png[/img]

Rose is very important to the later half of the story and a fair amount of it is centered on Niko trying to break Rose out of his shell as they’re now coworkers. However, it can be hard for 2 reasons:
[olist]
[*] Rose isn’t a love interest
[*] Rose doesn’t respond honestly (and hardly at all) to others
[/olist]
[b]Rose isn’t a love interest[/b] – Ren is. This is a romance game about Niko and Ren’s growing relationship rather than a simulator game where there’s multiple love interests. It’s surprisingly hard to balance having scenes between two characters that could theoretically date but aren’t going to. The overall focus is on Niko and Ren, but Niko and Rose’s relationship is also important to the later half of the game – it’s just not romantic.

[b]Rose doesn’t respond honestly[/b] – Rose is a very timid person, mainly because he doesn’t have much confidence in himself. Rose is similar to how Niko is at the start of the game, but the interesting thing about their relationship is that by the time they meet, Niko is a different person. He’s not overly confident, but the Niko that Rose meets has become more confident in himself and more comfortable with others than the Niko we first met at the beginning of the game – it’s only because of meeting Ren that Niko changes. So, in a way, it becomes Niko’s job to do the same for someone else.

[quote=Canvas Menagerie – Act 2]I swab some lavender paint, hesitating to lay it down on the canvas. Just as I reach over to my phone, there’s the sound of one of the doors opening. —And then, the door to my painting nook.

Rose “Ah—”
Niko “Oh.”

As probably the last person I thought I’d see, Rose steps in the warehouse room. Just as quickly as he stepped in, he looks like he’s about to run off again.

Niko “What are you doing here?”
Rose “I—”
Rose “I got turned around...”

How do you get so lost to end up here?!

Niko “What were you looking for?”
Rose “...The script reading rooms.”

Wow. I know this studio can be confusing to navigate, but that’s a whole new level.

Niko “That’s...kinda far away...”
Niko “W-Wait, I didn’t mean to laugh!”

Rose tries to hide his face and shut the door, but I quickly reopen it. I’m not good enough at giving directions so he’ll definitely be lost if I don’t help him.

Niko “Do you have to be there immediately?”
Rose “...No?”
Niko “Well, if you’ll give me a minute to clean up then I can walk you down there.”
Rose “...”
Rose “...Sure.”

He says everything with a careful pause.[/quote]
I call Rose "frustrating" because, while I do like him, I sometimes feel like I’m Niko while writing his scenes – it feels like I’m trying to pull any kind of information out of him with little to no avail, just like Niko. I hope by the end though we’re able to see Rose’s true colors!

During May our playtesting for Act 1 was in full steam (and still on going). While I haven't sat down to go over all of the feedback I've received yet, I have made a few small changes based on early feedback, such as making the subtitles for the filming sections easier to read.

[b]Before:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/c37a1251bd5f31279edae6e55102ea927cd9ae15.png[/img]

[b]After:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/08b313b0e3ba3e1046dc6e65b678b84f89602913.png[/img]

Once more changes have been implemented based on feedback, I'll be updating the demo.

Last but not least, May 31st is a special day – it’s Niko’s birthday!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/264c7997c6aaf2c49d5358db6edddb1da3f26bd1.jpg[/img]

But I’m writing this in June a few days late because I was out of town, so...

[h3]HAPPY PRIDE![/h3]

notes.title: Women's Day Sale + Game Updates!
notes.content:
Hiya, today is the first day of the Women's Day Sale on Steam! It's a 10-day long festival celebrating games made by women and women-led teams. Canvas Menagerie is taking part in it as well! To go with the festivities, we'll be running a playthrough of the demo through Steam broadcast and we have some new game updates.

To start off, Valentine's Day was earlier this month! I drew couples chibis of Niko & Ren to celebrate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/45ea5d1ec15ddc85ea5147fb76faa006eb1dd8b4.png[/img]

Maybe they’ll be [url=https://ko-fi.com/crystalgameworks/shop]available as stickers[/url] soon? Who knows~

Now onto writing! I ended up writing about 8k for Canvas Menagerie in February, with me taking a break from writing it the last week of February. That brings the current wordcount for Canvas Menagerie to 120,606 words! I’m estimating it to be around 150k when it’s fully finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/c496eb1e775fc7808221fff573c80ab2904164b3.jpg[/img]

I was also able to hammer out a scene by scene outline for the rest of the script. I had a vague idea of where I wanted to go with it and knew some scenes I wanted to hit, but nothing set (mostly) in stone until now. The last part of the game shows Niko & Ren’s growing relationship and wrapping up some of the loose ends from prior parts, namely about Ren’s relationship with his family.

Last but not least in February I started working towards getting the first 1/3rd of the game ready for playtesting. For the most part this means editing the script and putting it all in Ren’Py (a process that can take a day for just a scene or two), but it also means drawing additional outfits for the cast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/d099a8ac70fb1066306fe5ab44a5ab245df2ff90.jpg[/img]

Almost all of the CGs are already done for the first section of the game (a lot of them are viewable in the demo), so a majority of the art left to do for it are these outfits for special occasions. For the outfits above, the cast is at a studio party.

For now though, consider checking out the demo! It contains several scenes from the first part of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427690

— Arimia

notes.title: January Updates - New Chapters + Art
notes.content:
Canvas Menagerie is a large boys love story told over 3 Acts, which represent different stages in the relationship between the main character Niko and his love interest Ren. Act 1 is them meeting and falling for each other, Act 2 is them starting to date, and Act 3 is them getting closer. Currently, the first 2 Acts have first drafts.

I started the new year with 5k written and I wrote 5k this month. That means there’s a total of 10k written out of an estimated 45k for the last section, as every Act was estimated to be around 45-50k words long. It’s my goal to not only finish writing the entire game by the end of the year but also make significant progress on the rest of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/eb4f530db3046d1adde76d410d6b6bf42d6e89d5.png[/img]

As for artwork, here's a few I haven't shared here. First is the new key art for the game of the main cast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/6311d622672e476cfcd97d16f19d7da643ceb3d2.jpg[/img]

Next is a CG from Act 1- I wonder what they're doing at a theme park?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/88330a7cfa725fb4a541a60cef417f43a38efb42.jpg[/img]

Another goal for this year is to fully script the 1st part of the game and let others playtest it so I can get feedback on it. A late 2024-early 2025 full release for the game is what’s currently planned.

If you’re interested in eventually beta testing Canvas Menagerie, [url=https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4]join our Discord[/url]! It’s small and is where I post a lot of updates & previews as they happen, as it’s easier to share small stuff there than tackle social media algorithms.

notes.title: July Updates - Writing and Scene Direction
notes.content:
The total script has now passed 95k words! Several scenes were added to the middle section of Act 2, namely involving Ren and a certain character introduced in Act 2.

Canvas Menagerie is structured to be somewhat episodic, where each Act is a different focus on the character's lives. Act 1 is a romance VN following Niko and Ren meeting and ending with them confessing. Acts 2 and 3 focus on their lives on set afterwards, dealing with interpersonal events and other spoilery stuff I won't get into here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/22b551d3a85a82404b39846bd9fa0cd17acaeb80.png[/img]

One scene written this past month in particular is the first time Niko and Ren have an actual argument as a couple.

The inciting incident is Ren posting a photo online of Niko asleep without his knowledge. To Ren, he’s used to having tons of photos being posted online without his knowledge, so something mundane (and not scandalous) is a nonissue to him. But to Niko, someone who browses the internet on private accounts only, it’s a breech of privacy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44079813/0f96a2d8a86b0ff67a61fc8ef845480c485eddc8.png[/img]
